messages:
maria: Sharing a new draft for the Usage & Billing cost-insight cards — trying a denser 3-column layout for org-level view. Want quick takes on readability, CTA prominence (invoice download), and org vs project toggles. Screenshot: https://figma.com/... :eyes: jonah: nice! Love denser cards for power users. Concern: token breakdown row gets cramped. Maybe we collapse token detail behind a chevron on small widths. rebecca: perf note — loading token-level histograms for 30 projects will add ~300ms+ to page render if we fetch everything. Suggest lazy-load charts or show a compact sparkline + "expand" action. sam-a11y: a11y quicknits: keyboard order must match visual order when we do 3-col grid; ensure each card is a focusable region with `role=\"region\" aria-labelledby` and visible focus ring. Color contrast: red token delta is 2.8:1 — needs darken. maria: good call. @jonah can we prototype collapsed token detail? @rebecca if we lazy-load what signals to use to prefetch? on hover/focus or intersection observer? jonah: collapsing idea: default show totals + top contributor tag, then `Show details` button that toggles inline expansion. Example markup: ```html
...token rows...
``` rebecca: prefetch rules: intersection-observer at 200px + keyboard focus should trigger fetch. Keep server side pagination for invoice items. leah: from CS — customers keep asking where invoice download lives after switching scopes. The CTA must be globally visible in scope header + inside card for quick download per-project. Also add copy: `Download invoice (CSV)`. oliver: product decision: keep single prominent "Download invoice" CTA in header for current scope, but add mini CTA in card. We should avoid duplicate analytics events — instrument both with same event name and scope param. maria: accessibility nit: keyboard I/O for multi-card should allow arrow-key nav between cards within grid. Sam, confirm arrows are okay vs tabs? Also we need a11y tests. sam-a11y: arrows are fine if we implement roving tabindex pattern. Add visible focus styles and screenreader announcements on expand/collapse (announce "details expanded" / "details collapsed"). rebecca: backend plan: for org view we'll return aggregated token totals per project and a light sparkline. Expand endpoint returns per-day token details. Will add `?prefetch=1` param to allow client prefetch on focus. jonah: visual: reduce padding to 12px, move token breakdown to small muted text, emphasize cost number with 16pt semibold. Also show delta pill with contrast-compliant colors and a tooltip for color meaning. leah: copy tweak: change `Cost` label to `Estimated cost this period` and add tooltip `Includes model + infra charges`. maria: proposal: ship variant A (3-col dense with collapse + header CTA) to 5% of orgs, measure: time-to-download, invoice CTA CTR, page load TTFB, and support tickets. Agreeable? oliver: +1. timeline: prototype by Thu, dev spike Fri, ship experiment next Wed. rebecca: will add lazy-load and spike for ARIA attributes. Ping me for API contract and I'll stub endpoints. jonah: will upload updated mock in Figma and include keyboard flow screenshots. :thumbsup: leah: I'll prep support doc copy and list known customers to invite to experiment. maria: thanks all — if no objections I'll lock the prototype requirements by EOD. :rocket:
